## MASTER PROMPT USE GUIDE

A Master Prompt is not a normal one-time prompt. It is a complete reusable AI system where the character, camera style, story DNA, duration, audio, continuity, negative rules, and output format are already defined.

**Simple workflow:**

1. Open a new ChatGPT or Claude chat and paste the complete Master Prompt.
2. Type: **“Give me 10 topics.”**
3. Select your favorite idea: **“Topic 4.”**
4. Then type: **“Make full prompt.”**
5. For changes, do not paste the full Master Prompt again. Simply say: **“Keep everything the same, change the location,” “make the hook stronger,” “make it 15 seconds,” “make the ending funnier,” or “keep the same character.”**
6. For more ideas, type: **“Give me 10 more topics”** or **“Next video.”**

Think of the Master Prompt as your permanent **Creative Director + Script Writer + Camera Director + Prompt Engineer.**

**The Master Prompt defines HOW to create.
Your next command defines WHAT to create.**

For a new chat, paste the Master Prompt again for the safest workflow.

Privacy Policy

NavPrompts ("we", "our", "us") operates the website navprompts.com. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our service.

We collect the following information:

  • Account information: Name and email address when you register.
  • Payment information: Payments are processed by our payment partners (Razorpay and Cryptomus). We never store your card numbers, UPI details, or wallet keys on our servers. We only receive payment confirmation IDs.
  • Usage data: Basic session cookies required to keep you logged in.

3. How We Use Your Information

  • To provide access to your subscription and member content.
  • To process payments and manage your membership.
  • To communicate important account or service updates.
  • To improve our service and prevent fraud or abuse.

4. Data Sharing

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to anyone. Your data is shared only with our payment processors (Razorpay, Cryptomus) strictly to process your transactions, and when required by law.

We use only essential cookies — a session cookie to keep you logged in. We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

6. Data Security

Your password is stored using industry-standard one-way encryption (bcrypt). All traffic to our website is encrypted via HTTPS/SSL. Access to member data is restricted to the site administrator only.

7. Data Retention & Deletion

Your account data is retained while your account is active. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting us — we will process the request within 7 business days.

8. Contact

For any privacy-related questions, contact us at our contact page or email support@navprompts.com.

Email us at support@navprompts.com from your registered email with the subject "Cancel Subscription", or use the contact page. We process cancellation requests within 24 hours.
